metadata.environment: Mininet 2.3.0 + Open vSwitch (OVS) 2.17.9 + Ryu 4.34 SDN Controller
metadata.traffic_tool: iperf 2.0.13 (UDP receiver-authoritative logging and TCP Reno)

discrepancy_resolution.diagnosis: Inconsistency between 4.37% loss and 38.18 Mbit/s throughput under 65.0 Mbit/s offered load is fully resolved by distinguishing client-side socket buffering from server-side receiver reception.
discrepancy_resolution.explanation: Receiver-authoritative logging at host h9 confirms 38.18 Mbit/s delivery across the 40.0 Mbit/s bottleneck. The 41.26% loss reflects end-to-end offered load drop (65 - 38.18)/65. The 4.37% loss reflects the datagram sequence gap recorded by the iperf server relative to packets successfully serialized past the client Linux socket buffer.
